entities.summary: Vyacheslav Mikolayovich Timchenko, is a Ukrainian retired professional ice hockey player. He played for multiple teams during a career that lasted from 1987 until 2014. He also played internationally for the Ukrainian national team at several World Championships, as well as the 2002 Winter Olympics.
